title: bug: Notes field not delivered to nightscout (at leats for carb correnctions)
symptom: When entering a note in the carbs dialog and sending a carb correction, the note is not delivered to Nightscout; the Notes column in Nightscout treatments is empty, and the notes field in the database is empty.
cause: The thread indicates that the notes field is not being sent to Nightscout in version 3.0.0.2, whereas it worked in 2.8.2. A maintainer comment suggests the database schema must be extended, implying the data structure may be missing the notes field.
evidence_quote: Note: db schema must be extended
